# Assumption of Moses Chapter 5 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Coming Western King and Priestly Rule

---

**1** Then a mighty king will come from the west, conquer them, and take possession of them.

**2** He will carry off captives as plunder and take some of them back to his own land.

**3** He will burn part of their sanctuary and will crucify some of them around their city.

**4** In those days a king will arise who will be arrogant and will show respect to no one, a man who will rule them as they deserve.

**5** He will judge them as they judged others, for they will have defiled the holy things of the Lord.

**6** For twenty years he will oppress them.

**7** Then a man from the tribe of Levi will arise who fears the Lord and acts with justice.

**8** His sons will rule after him for a limited time.

**9** After a short while the kingdom will be diminished, and forces of mixed and impure origin will trouble it.

**10** Then a powerful king from the west will come and conquer them and lead them away.

**11** These commanders will become minor rulers with authority over many nations.

**12** They will burn a temple and carry off its gold.

**13** Those living in the land will be in great distress for a long time.

**14** But there will come an appointed time when the Lord deals with them.
